description:
I am an AI engineer focused on agentic workflows, RAG systems, and AI safety. For NASA Space Apps, I am developing Flame in Freefall, an AI-powered research assistant that analyzes NASA's microgravity combustion data.

Built with Python, LangGraph, and Groq, it retrieves verified experiment information, including FLEX and BASS, and applies governance guardrails to prevent unsupported outputs. When evidence or confidence is insufficient, it refuses to provide unverified safety insights.
